title: Impressing the Locals
start: Talk to Trader Stan in Port Sarim about the Skulls pirate named Jed.

recommended.t: Activated Port Sarim and Draynor lodestones

rewards.t: Ability to use the teleport on the chests of the Elite Dungeons

steps.t: Right click to talk to Trader Stan located at the south-eastern dock of Port Sarim. [Chat: 2 Talk about the Skulls pirate, Jed. › Accept › 1 About a quartermaster. › 2 About a navigator. › 3 About a bosun. › 4 Never mind.] Finish all dialogue.
Talk to Guard Captain Roarkwin in the Port Sarim jail located to the west. Finish all dialogue.
Enter the port portal near the northern dock.

sub.t: Ignore the dialogue about Meg which triggers after you enter the portal.

steps.t: Talk to Seasinger Umi to the southeast of the portal. Finish all dialogue.
Talk to the Barmaid in a building to the northwest of the portal. [Chat: 1 Yes.]
Climb up the stairs and talk to Mister Gully.
Head to the pottery house in Draynor Village and climb up the stairs.
Talk to the Black Knight sergeant.

sub.t: If your character does not talk about Jacob, make sure you finish all dialogue with Guard Captain Roarkwin.

steps.t: Head to Rimmington and talk to Seasinger Jemi near the well.
Back at the Port Sarim docks, talk to Trader Stan. [Chat: 2 Talk about the Skulls pirate, Jed.]

get_inside.text: Outside of The Rusty Anchor Inn
Players can teleport to Port Sarim using the Home Teleport spell once they have activated Port Sarim lodestone.
Port Sarim can be entered by land from Falador to the north/north-west, Draynor Village to the east, Rimmington to the west, or Thurgo's Peninsula to the south.
If a player has the explorer's ring 3 or 4 equipped or in their inventory, they can teleport to the Falador cabbage patch north of the area and walk south.
Players can also travel by ship from Karamja, Crandor, or Entrana, arriving at the dock.

Players can also travel to Port Sarim jail directly from Al Kharid by telling Shantay that they are outlaws. If they disagree to his terms, he will teleport them to Port Sarim jail. They can then pick the lock (both F2P and P2P) in their cell to get out.
Fairy ring (code AIQ) travels to Mudskipper Point, the southern extent of Thurgo's Peninsula, south of Port Sarim.
Using the teleport option on the Arc Journal obtained from Sharkborne. Requires completion of Impressing the Locals.
Travel to Crafting Guild via the skills necklace or balloon transport system and walk to the south-east.
